scraped.scraped_description: Privacy Badger is a browser extension that stops advertisers and other third-party trackers from secretly tracking where you go and what pages you look at on the web.  If an advertiser seems to be tracking you across multiple websites without your permission, Privacy Badger automatically blocks that advertiser from loading any more content in your browser.  To the advertiser, it s like you suddenly disappeared.

name: Privacy Badger
tagline: A free browser extension made by EFF to stop companies from spying on you online.
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 - Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: dependent on browser vendor APIs (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)
Google Manifest V3 API changes may restrict extension capabilities
academic_citations: Englehardt, S., & Narayanan, A. (2016). Online tracking: A 1-million-site measurement and analysis. Proceedings of the 2016 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security.
Mayer, J. R., & Mitchell, J. C. (2012). Third-party web tracking: Policy and technology. 2012 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy.
policy_outcomes: Sends Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track signals on behalf of users
Documents canvas-based fingerprinting via Cover Your Tracks project
outcome_methodology: heuristic tracker detection; automated learning via Badger Sett training project
documented_limitations: Changed from heuristic learning to pre-trained blocklist in 2020 after Google Security Team disclosed fingerprinting vulnerability
Primarily protects against third-party tracking, not first-party
Cannot prevent all forms of fingerprinting
failure_modes: tracker evasion techniques evolve faster than blocking rules
governance_model: Maintained by EFF staff; open source contributions accepted via GitHub
curation_criteria: Blocks third-party trackers that ignore Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track signals
controversies: 2020: Google Security Team disclosed that Privacy Badger's heuristic learning could be exploited to fingerprint users; EFF changed default behaviour
